title: Anthropic’s OSS Scanner: What Open-Source Maintainers Need to Know
snippet: Anthropic has launched OSS Scanner, a free service that uses AI agents to search eligible open-source repositories for security vulnerabilities. The headline is easy to understand. The operating model deserves more attention. OSS Scanner does not work like Anthropic’s usual coordinated vulnerability disclosure process. Instead of waiting for people to validate every finding, the service can send model-generated reports directly to participating maintainers. That choice makes reporting faster. It also means maintainers must be prepared to verify the results themselves. This article explains how the service works, which projects can apply, what maintainers may receive and what teams should prepare before enrolling.
